fixtures.title: Resistor explanation with request for shorter follow-up

factualPoints: Resistors limit current and reduce voltage in a circuit
Ohm's Law relationship V = I * R

request.message: Can you give me a shorter explanation of what a resistor does in a 5V LED circuit?

context.text: A resistor resists electric current flow. In electronic circuits, resistors are used to reduce current flow, adjust signal levels, divide voltages, bias active elements, and terminate transmission lines. For an LED on a 5V power supply, a current limiting resistor prevents burning out the diode.

message.content: A resistor throttles electric current in your circuit. For a 5V LED, it drops the excess voltage so safe current (typically 15–20mA) reaches the LED, preventing it from burning out instantly.

fixtures.title: Known-input LED calculation checked against deterministic helper

factualPoints: Ideal resistor value is 150 ohms
Nearest standard E12 resistor is 150 ohms
Resulting current is 20 mA
Power dissipation is 60 mW, safe for standard 1/4W resistor

request.message: What resistor do I need for a 5V supply with a red LED (2.0V forward drop) at 20mA?

message.content:
Using Ohm's Law: R = (Vs - Vf) / I = (5.0V - 2.0V) / 0.02A = 150 Ω.

• Ideal resistance: 150 Ω
• Standard E12 value: 150 Ω
• Resulting current: 20.0 mA
• Resistor power dissipation: P = 3.0V × 0.02A = 60 mW (well within 250mW for a 1/4W resistor).

fixtures.title: Missing voltage/current requiring clarification before advising

mustAcknowledge: Kailangan malaman ang kulay o forward voltage (Vf) ng LED
mustNotClaim: gamitin mo agad ang 220 ohm nang walang tanong

request.message: Anong resistor ang gagamitin ko para sa LED ko?

message.content:
Para makapili tayo ng tamang resistor value gamit ang R = (Vs - Vf) / I, kailangan muna natin ang tatlong values:
1. Supply voltage (Vs) — halimbawa 5V mula sa Arduino o 9V battery?
2. Kulay ng LED (Vf) — halimbawa red (~2.0V), green (~2.2V), o blue (~3.2V)?
3. Target current (I) — karaniwang 10mA hanggang 20mA para sa indicator LED.

Paki-share ang power source at kulay ng LED para makalkula natin ang eksaktong standard E12 resistor.
